name: Promotions
description: Black has rolled 5 and 6 (infantry or leader), and holds Yellow's Rook. Black's Western Pawn on b7, stepping to b8, becomes a Queen, Rook, Bishop or Knight, or the captured Rook. Black's Minister already stands on the far edge, c8: it may become the captured Rook. Black's Silver General on e5, moving into the far three rows, may become a Gold General.
